# logto_id_token_config

ID-token extended claims, including existing role claims.

`configuration` is a JSON object containing the API fields this resource owns.
Omitted fields remain unmanaged. Import uses `default`.
Destroy only releases Terraform ownership; it does not reset tenant settings.
